business.hours: The phone line is answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by an automated assistant.
business.description: A free phone line for pool service, pool cleaning and pool repair across Tucson and the Tucson metro. An automated assistant answers 24/7 and transfers callers to an independent, locally owned pool service company.
business.short_disclosure: Tucson Pool Cleaning Pro is a free phone line, not a pool company. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local pool service company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly.
business.referral_disclosure: Companies may pay a referral fee. The line never charges you.
